prompts: We need a landing page, {WS}/landing/index.html in a single file, for the story of Piet Mondrian's "Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow" (1930). The facts are in {WS}/FACTSHEET.md, and nothing beyond them should be claimed. A visitor should leave knowing the painter, the year, the movement and why the work matters, and be invited to read more at the source the fact sheet gives. The page itself should speak Mondrian's visual language. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] [Open the landing page](./landing/index.html). It works directly from disk without a build step or external assets.

[action] I used the fact sheet for all historical claims and interpreted the visual brief as an original diagram of the composition. The page identifies Mondrian, 1930 and De Stijl, explains the work’s influence on graphic design and architecture, and links to the supplied source.

[result] I inspected the desktop render. Browser checks at 1440px and 390px both returned `"overflow":false` and `"links":true`, confirming that the content fits horizontally, the navigation targets exist and the source URL matches.

[next] The browser acknowledged its close command. Automatic review blocked the final process check and scratch-folder cleanup, so `tmp/` remains.
